title: Patch-identified neuron localization under channel degradation
scientific_question: Can a general agent localize an identified extracellular spike source from multichannel waveforms and assess how channel degradation changes accuracy and reliability?

skill_dimensions.tool_use: Parse waveforms and geometry with correct units; execute fixed scientific analyses.
skill_dimensions.neural_understanding: Use spatial action-potential structure, probe geometry, noise and reference uncertainty.
skill_dimensions.analytical_reasoning: Compare estimators under shared masks and distinguish localization accuracy from stability.
skill_dimensions.scientific_reasoning: Recognize selected-cohort and approximate-reference limits and use grouped evaluation. These are design aims; independent construct validity and narrative scoring have not been established.

official_code.dependency_limit: The reviewed repository tree lacks util_loc while util_eval imports it. Notebook dispatch and the complete dependency closure require separate verification; absent dependencies are not licensed or replaced by assumption.

data.scope: Author-derived experimental spike/waveform/template archive for the 11 selected pairs. This does not cover all 43 source pairs or all 25 published simulation combinations.
data.rights_gate: Verify the original-source access terms, archive contents and item-level rights before extracting or redistributing materials.

reference_and_intervention.spike_identity: Matched patch-clamp spike times define extracellular waveform extraction. This tests localization of an identified source, not spike detection.
reference_and_intervention.location: Approximate patch/probe spatial reference, with calibration uncertainty still to establish; not exact biological soma coordinates.
reference_and_intervention.channel_degradation: Published intervention replaces selected channels with 50 microvolt Gaussian noise. This is artificial signal corruption, not measured chronic electrode failure.
reference_and_intervention.drift: Distance from a method’s own undegraded estimate is a stability diagnostic. A constant predictor has zero apparent drift but may localize poorly; no genuine in-vivo motion claim follows.
reference_and_intervention.threshold: Final journal accuracy uses strict distance < 50 micrometres. This is an evaluation convention, not known calibration accuracy. No unsupported historical threshold comparison is used.

input_and_support.admission: Authenticate the complete archive and notebook, then freeze every selected cell, recording, spike, electrode and archived condition. Verify axes, sampling/gain/voltage/coordinate units and patch/probe joins before activation.
owner_manifest_fields: condition, corruption level and seed identity
contact geometry and axes in micrometres
private_fields: patch/probe spatial calibration or other target proxies
original IDs or paths that reveal answers
patch traces or features revealing target location
author predictions, cached notebook outputs and figures
corruption seeds/masks in the default unknown-mask condition
input_and_support.support_rule: No outcome-dependent removal of weak cells, inconvenient conditions or missing predictions. Every source support item retains a typed status; incomplete or invalid output cannot earn a reduced-denominator score.
input_and_support.unknowns: Actual array members, axes, condition counts, animal identities and all join cardinalities remain construction gates; none are inferred from archive availability.

information_modes.description: Agent investigates each admitted case using allowed signals, Python and fixed tools, then returns coordinates and structured evidence within a fixed budget.
Agent develops one predictor on development groups; the evaluator freezes it and runs it on every complete held-out group and degradation condition.

code_access_factor.without_official_code: Same neutral schema, paper/method description and toolchain, without author analysis code.
code_access_factor.with_official_code: Same data and budget plus admitted computation cells/scripts at the pinned revision. Strip cached answers and output cells only after preserving and inspecting the complete original notebook.
code_access_factor.enforcement: Both authoring and execution must use owner-staged arm-specific resources with a fixed external-access policy; no repository retrieval may bypass the no-code arm.
code_access_factor.counting: Information modes and code availability are experimental conditions within this one draft.

split_and_selection.group: Keep every paired cell’s recordings, spikes and degradation trajectory together. Join repeated recordings and animal identities before making outer folds; known animal overlap forces shared folds.
split_and_selection.animal_identity_gate: Unknown animal identity blocks animal-generalization claims. Any leave-cell-out engineering analysis must be separately labeled; 11 pairs are not assumed to be 11 animals.
split_and_selection.protocol: Freeze complete deterministic grouped outer splits before results. Tune only in development groups; keep test targets private. No random spike or trial split.
split_and_selection.intervention_selection: Fix all masks and noise seeds independently of target coordinates and candidate results. Preserve published masks for reproduction; new-seed generalization needs a separate frozen manifest.
split_and_selection.small_cohort: Show all group results. Use descriptive paired differences if too few independent groups support reliable inference; do not manufacture significance.
split_and_selection.public_exposure: Opaque IDs and hidden local labels do not establish that public data or notebook answers were absent from model training.

submission.rows: Exactly one row per requested spike or template, keyed by opaque case, condition and spike-or-template ID.
submission.prediction: Two finite coordinates in the verified probe-plane axes and micrometres. The actual source must establish the axes before activation.
submission.freeze: Owner hashes one program and its dependencies before final evaluation; the program cannot change across conditions.
submission.optional_evidence: Structured per-condition reasoning may be retained for analysis; it is not an established freeform reward-model score.

scoring.per_row: Euclidean distance to the verified approximate spatial reference.
scoring.per_cell_condition: Fraction of all admitted requested spikes with distance < 50 micrometres. Template accuracy is reported separately.
scoring.primary: Macro accuracy over the complete fixed condition grid, with within-cell/condition averaging, equal cell/recording weighting within animal, then equal animal weighting. Freeze the exact hierarchy after actual overlap joins.
mandatory_reporting: continuous median distance per cell/condition and macro summary
template error and accuracy separately from spike accuracy
stability relative to each method’s undegraded estimate alongside absolute error
coverage, invalid output and resource use
scoring.failure: Protocol failure on incomplete/invalid output; no silent intersection. Incorrect but valid predictions keep the full denominator.
scoring.uncertainty: Paired independent-group differences; bootstrap groups only when actual group count and a preregistered method justify it. No spike-level confidence inflation.
scoring.numerical_policy: No invented numerical tolerance or biological equivalence margin.

native_parity_gates: fresh output versus cached result distinction

truth_conditioned_retry.finding: The helper retries while groundtruth-derived n_right < 1 and counter < 10, accumulating correct and incorrect counts. Its active use in the experimental path is unverified in this reviewed specification. This is not proof that published results used the path.
truth_conditioned_retry.required_resolution: Audit the complete notebook callgraph. If active, preserve faithful historical diagnostic behavior separately and independently define fixed-support, fixed-attempt, target-independent benchmark inference. Do not silently patch author behavior and claim native parity, or compare truth-assisted outputs as a deployable baseline.

negative_controls: destroyed waveform values with unchanged allowed metadata
published aggregate answer without case joins
interpretation_controls: metadata-only baselines checked for target shortcuts

improvement_claim: Improvement requires paired group-level evidence against competent admitted baselines on identical complete support and resources, with uncertainty. No tuning on held-out coordinates, favorable subset selection, or extrapolation from 11 selected pairs to all 43 or new animals without evidence.
construction_gates: complete archive checksum/member census and rights audit
lossless neutral conversion and all support/animal/coordinate joins
protected evaluator, grouped split and scorer with independent arithmetic verification
original baseline execution under a pinned environment and budget
prospectively authorized agent comparison only after qualification
counting: One dataset-family draft. Methods, cells, spikes, folds, conditions, controls and source versions do not add benchmarks.
evidence_scope: Projection of accepted localization contract V3 and its independent source review at registration. Later notebook investigations are outside this frozen specification until independently reviewed.
